doc.title: Jack Lesberg interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997

chapter: New York, NBC and Eddie Condon's
title: NBC staff job and the dance orchestra with Eddie Safranski
summary: He got an NBC staff job in 1944-45 replacing a serviceman, playing with the NBC Symphony and dance orchestra alongside Eddie Safranski.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working radio and television: network shows, studio staffs, talk-show bands

blocks.x: Symphony and as well as the dance orchestra. Eddie Safranski and I were the two hot guys, and they would add us to the other six who were playing with the NBC Orchestra.
Is that the term they used, the “hot guys?”

Well maybe — no I think that’s my own. No we weren’t that hot. But we did play with the dance orchestra, you know they’d have Bing Crosby come out, because these were all staff programs you know, not so much, it was all radio just then. And I had a lot of experience with that. I stayed with the station there just for a short period you know. I was taking a serviceman’s place, he was called to service, and that’s how I got the job.
